description:
Diagnostic workflow for an unhealthy stack. Internally: what is deployed
(clawops_status) → the stack's failed health checks (clawops_doctor) → the
gateway's last 50 log lines (clawops_logs_tail) → a report with next steps that
name the tool for each kind of failure. Changes nothing.

Use when: the user reports any "not working" symptom and you don't know
where to start. Best entry point for troubleshooting.

Do NOT use when: the user has already identified the problem and asks for
a specific fix.

stackName.description: Which stack to diagnose. Omitted = the default stack in ~/.clawops/config.json

name: clawops_workflow_recover
title: Recover/Diagnose Stack
